t: This is a base of Arup, the British professional services firm, which is headquartered in London. Arup provides design, engineering, architecture, planning and advisory services across the built environment. It employs about seventeen thousand people in over ninety offices in thirty-five countries. The firm was founded by Sir Ove Arup, an engineer of Danish heritage who is considered one of the foremost structural engineers in architecture of his time. His name is still on the firm today.
